articles.title_en: Asymmetric auctions: Perturbations, ε- equilibrium, and equilibrium
articles.title_cn: 非对称拍卖：扰动、ε-均衡与均衡
articles.abstract_en: We consider first-price auctions with independent and private valuations that have asymmetric valuation distributions and supports. We first show the existence of equilibrium in these auctions through a perturbation approach, thereby establishing that the limit of Bayesian Nash equilibria (BNE) of such perturbed auctions is indeed the Bayesian Nash equilibrium (BNE) of the limit auction with asymmetric supports. We then characterize this BNE and show that the ε-equilibrium (ε-BNE) of the auction with asymmetric supports is a BNE of “close” auctions with common supports. We then demonstrate some numerical examples.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有独立私有估值且估值分布和支持集非对称的一级价格拍卖。我们首先通过扰动方法证明这些拍卖中均衡的存在性，从而确立了此类扰动拍卖的贝叶斯纳什均衡（BNE）的极限确实是非对称支持集极限拍卖的贝叶斯纳什均衡（BNE）。然后我们刻画了这一BNE，并证明了具有非对称支持集的拍卖的ε-均衡（ε-BNE）是具有共同支持集的“接近”拍卖的BNE。最后，我们展示了一些数值例子。

articles.title_en: Bicriteria Nash flows over time
articles.title_cn: 双准则的随时间变化的纳什流
articles.abstract_en: Flows over time are a natural way to incorporate flow dynamics that arise in various applications such as traffic networks. In this paper we introduce a natural variant of the deterministic fluid queuing model in which users aim to minimize their costs subject to arrival at their destination before a pre-specified deadline. We determine the existence and the structure of Nash flows over time and fully characterize the price of anarchy for this model. The price of anarchy measures the ratio of the quality of the equilibrium and the quality of the optimum flow, where we evaluate the quality using two different natural performance measures: the throughput for a given deadline and the makespan for a given amount of flow. While it turns out that both prices of anarchy can be unbounded in general, we provide tight bounds for the important subclass of parallel path graphs.
articles.abstract_cn: 随时间变化的流是一种自然的方式，用以纳入在各种应用（如交通网络）中出现的流动动态。在本文中，我们引入了确定性流体排队模型的一个自然变体，其中用户旨在最小化其成本，同时满足在预定截止时间前到达目的地。我们确定了随时间变化的纳什流的存在性和结构，并全面刻画了该模型的无政府状态价格。无政府状态价格衡量均衡质量与最优流质量之比，其中我们使用两种不同的自然性能指标来评估质量：给定截止时间的吞吐量和给定流量的完工时间。虽然结果表明，这两种无政府状态价格在一般情况下都可能无界，但我们为并行路径图这一重要子类提供了紧的界。

articles.title_en: The existence of a pure-strategy Nash equilibrium in a discrete ponds dilemma
articles.title_cn: 离散池塘困境中纯策略纳什均衡的存在性
articles.abstract_en: In a variety of economic situations discrete agents choose one resource among several available resources and, once admitted to the resource of choice, divide it among fellow agents admitted there. The amount of the resource an agent gets is proportional to her relative ability to acquire this particular resource, what we refer to as an agent's weight at the resource. The relevant applications include students self-selecting into colleges, politicians self-selecting into races, and athletes self-selecting into teams. We find that this game has a pure-strategy Nash equilibrium in at least three special cases: 1) when agents have the same weight at each resource, 2) when all resources are the same, 3) when there are only two resources. We also show that this game always has an approximate Nash equilibrium when the number of players is large. Existence in the general case remains an open problem.
articles.abstract_cn: 在各种经济情境中，离散的代理人从若干可用资源中选择一种资源，一旦被所选资源接纳，便在同样被接纳的代理人之间分配该资源。代理人获得的资源量与其获取该特定资源的相对能力成正比，我们称之为代理人在该资源上的权重。相关应用包括学生自主选择大学、政治家自主选择竞选、运动员自主选择队伍。我们发现，该博弈在至少三种特殊情况下存在纯策略纳什均衡：1）当代理人在每种资源上具有相同权重时，2）当所有资源相同时，3）当只有两种资源时。我们还表明，当参与者数量较大时，该博弈总是存在近似纳什均衡。一般情况下的存在性仍是一个开放问题。

articles.title_en: Clubs and networks
articles.title_cn: 俱乐部与网络
articles.abstract_en: A recurring theme in the study of society is the concentration of influence and power that is driven through unequal membership of groups and associations. In some instances, these bodies constitute a small world while in others they are fragmented into distinct cliques. This paper presents a new model of clubs and networks to understand the sources of individual marginalization and the origins of small and large worlds.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会研究中的一个反复出现的主题是，通过群体和协会的不平等成员资格所驱动的影响力和权力的集中。在某些情况下，这些组织构成了一个小世界，而在其他情况下，它们则分裂为不同的派系。本文提出了一个关于俱乐部和网络的新模型，以理解个体边缘化的根源以及小世界和大世界的起源。

articles.title_en: Peace in an unequal world? Experimental evidence on the relationship between inequality and conflict in a guns-vs-butter setting
articles.title_cn: 不平等世界中的和平？关于枪支与黄油背景下不平等与冲突关系的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This study addresses the emergence of (unarmed) peace and investments in arms within a guns-vs-butter conflict setting. We introduce a novel feature within the conflict game and separate the decision to start a conflict and the investment in arms, following the theoretical framework of Garfinkel and Syropoulos (2021). Based on this model we experimentally examine the emergence of peace while varying resource inequality among conflicting parties. We find that inequality leads to more conflicts and higher investments in arms. Despite these trends, achieving a state of unarmed peace is rarely observed in both treatments. Our results highlight the critical role of trust in attaining peaceful outcomes and show that armed peace, although not an optimal strategy in either treatment, is one of the most frequently chosen decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了在枪支与黄油冲突背景下（非武装）和平的出现以及武器投资问题。我们在冲突博弈中引入了一个新特征，将发动冲突的决定与武器投资分开，遵循Garfinkel和Syropoulos（2021）的理论框架。基于该模型，我们通过实验考察了在冲突各方之间资源不平等变化时和平的出现情况。我们发现，不平等导致更多的冲突和更高的武器投资。尽管存在这些趋势，但在两种处理方式中，实现非武装和平的状态都很少被观察到。我们的结果强调了信任在实现和平结果中的关键作用，并表明武装和平虽然在两种处理方式中都不是最优策略，但却是最常被选择的决策之一。

articles.title_en: Random partitions, potential, value, and externalities
articles.title_cn: 随机划分、势、值与外部性
articles.abstract_en: The Shapley value equals a player's contribution to the potential of a game. The potential is a most natural one-number summary of a game, which can be computed as the expected accumulated worth of a random partition of the players. This computation integrates the coalition formation of all players and readily extends to games with externalities. We investigate those potential functions for games with externalities that can be computed this way. It turns out that the potential that corresponds to the MPW solution introduced by Macho-Stadler et al. (2007, J. Econ. Theory 135, 339–356) is unique in the following sense. It is obtained as the expected accumulated worth of a random partition, it generalizes the potential for games without externalities, and it induces a solution that satisfies the null player property even in the presence of externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: Shapley值等于一个博弈中某个参与者对势的贡献。势是博弈最自然的一维概括，可以通过随机划分参与者的期望累积价值来计算。这种计算整合了所有参与者的联盟形成，并容易扩展到具有外部性的博弈。我们研究了那些可以通过这种方式计算的具有外部性的博弈的势函数。结果表明，与Macho-Stadler等人（2007，J. Econ. Theory 135，339-356）引入的MPW解相对应的势在以下意义上是独特的。它作为随机划分的期望累积价值获得，推广了无外部性博弈的势，并且即使在存在外部性的情况下，它也诱导出一个满足零参与者性质的解。

articles.title_en: Strategy-proofness with single-peaked and single-dipped preferences
articles.title_cn: 单峰与单谷偏好下的策略防止性
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the problem of locating a public facility in a domain of single-peaked and single-dipped preferences when the social planner knows the type of preference (single-peaked or single-dipped) of each agent. Our main result characterizes all strategy-proof rules and shows that they can be decomposed into two steps. In the first step, the agents with single-peaked preferences are asked about their peaks and, for each profile of reported peaks, at most two alternatives are preselected. In the second step, the agents with single-dipped preferences are asked to reveal their dips to complete the decision between the preselected alternatives. Our result generalizes the findings of Moulin (1980) and Barberà and Jackson (1994) for single-peaked and of Manjunath (2014) for single-dipped preferences. Finally, we show that all strategy-proof rules are also group strategy-proof and analyze the implications of Pareto efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在单峰和单谷偏好域中选址公共设施的问题，此时社会规划者知道每个代理人的偏好类型（单峰或单谷）。我们的主要结果刻画了所有策略防止规则，并表明它们可以分解为两个步骤。第一步，具有单峰偏好的代理人被询问其峰值，对于每个报告的峰值分布，最多预选两个备选方案。第二步，具有单谷偏好的代理人被要求揭示其谷值，以完成预选备选方案之间的决策。我们的结果推广了Moulin（1980）和Barberà与Jackson（1994）关于单峰偏好以及Manjunath（2014）关于单谷偏好的发现。最后，我们表明所有策略防止规则也是群体策略防止的，并分析了帕累托效率的含义。

articles.title_en: Reputation-based persuasion platforms
articles.title_cn: 基于声誉的说服平台
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a two-stage Bayesian persuasion model in which a third-party platform controls the information available to the sender about users' preferences. We aim to characterize the optimal information disclosure policy of the platform, which maximizes average user utility, under the assumption that the sender also follows its own optimal policy. We show that this problem can be reduced to a model of market segmentation, in which probabilities are mapped into valuations. We then introduce a repeated variation of the persuasion platform problem in which myopic users arrive sequentially. In this setting, the platform controls the sender's information about users and maintains a reputation for the sender, punishing it if it fails to act truthfully on a certain subset of signals. We provide a characterization of the optimal platform policy in the reputation-based setting, which is then used to simplify the optimization problem of the platform.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们引入了一个两阶段贝叶斯说服模型，其中第三方平台控制发送者可获得的关于用户偏好的信息。我们旨在刻画平台的最优信息披露政策，该政策在假设发送者也遵循其自身最优政策的前提下，最大化平均用户效用。我们证明该问题可以简化为一个市场细分模型，其中概率被映射为估值。随后，我们引入了说服平台问题的重复变体，其中短视用户依次到达。在这种设定下，平台控制发送者关于用户的信息，并维护发送者的声誉，如果发送者在某一特定信号子集上未能如实行动，则对其进行惩罚。我们提供了基于声誉设定下最优平台政策的刻画，并利用该刻画简化平台的优化问题。

articles.title_en: Gender and cooperation in the presence of negative externalities
articles.title_cn: 负外部性存在下的性别与合作
articles.abstract_en: Social dilemmas often impose negative externalities on third parties. We experimentally analyze gender differences in cooperation in such a setting, i.e., a prisoner's dilemma game, with a passive third party that may be harmed when active players mutually cooperate. Applying a within-subjects setting, we compare cooperation under anonymity and social information, as personal characteristics are commonly known in real-life relations. Results show that the presence of a negative externality particularly affects guilt-averse women, who cooperate less often independently of the degree of information they receive. No gender difference is found absent negative externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会困境常常对第三方施加负外部性。我们通过实验分析了在这种情境下，即囚徒困境博弈中，当主动参与者相互合作时可能伤害被动第三方的情况下，性别在合作上的差异。采用被试内设计，我们比较了匿名和社会信息条件下的合作，因为在现实关系中个人特征通常是已知的。结果表明，负外部性的存在特别影响有内疚规避倾向的女性，她们无论获得何种程度的信息，合作频率都较低。在没有负外部性的情况下，未发现性别差异。

articles.title_en: School choice with independent versus consolidated districts
articles.title_cn: 独立学区与合并学区的择校问题
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the welfare effects of school district consolidation. Using incomplete rank-ordered lists (ROLs) submitted for admission to the Hungarian secondary school system, we estimate complete ROLs assuming that parents do not use dominated strategies and that the matching outcome is stable. These estimates aid in constructing a counterfactual district-based assignment and discerning the factors driving parents' preferences over schools. We find that district consolidation leads to large welfare gains in Budapest, equivalent to students attending a school five kilometres closer to their residences. These gains offset the additional travel distances incurred in the consolidated assignment. 73% of matched students benefit from district consolidation, while fewer than 3% are assigned to a less preferred school. Students from smaller and less under-demanded districts benefit relatively more, as well as those with high academic ability. Using reported preferences instead of estimated ones also yields large gains from district consolidation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了学区合并的福利效应。利用匈牙利中学入学申请中提交的不完整排序列表（ROLs），我们假设家长不使用占优策略且匹配结果稳定，从而估计出完整的排序列表。这些估计有助于构建反事实的学区分配，并识别影响家长对学校偏好的因素。我们发现，在布达佩斯，学区合并带来了巨大的福利收益，相当于学生就读的学校距离其住所近了五公里。这些收益抵消了合并分配中产生的额外旅行距离。73%的匹配学生受益于学区合并，而不到3%的学生被分配到不太偏好的学校。来自较小且需求不足程度较低的学区的学生，以及学业能力较高的学生，受益相对更多。使用报告的偏好而非估计的偏好，也能从学区合并中获得巨大收益。

articles.title_en: An observability paradox in linked enforcement
articles.title_cn: 关联执法中的可观测性悖论
articles.abstract_en: The presence of observation errors limits players' ability to detect deviations, and hence the possibility of efficient cooperation in repeated games. When players interact repeatedly in multiple games with imperfect observation in at least one game, however, we find a novel spillover effect that enhances players' ability to sustain cooperation. This finding suggests the presence of observation error can increase the likelihood of efficient cooperation when players interact in multiple repeated games simultaneously. Our result has important implications for industrial organizations, relational contracts, and international cooperation.
articles.abstract_cn: 观测误差的存在限制了参与者检测偏离的能力，从而限制了重复博弈中有效合作的可能性。然而，当参与者在至少一个博弈中存在不完全观测的情况下，在多个博弈中重复互动时，我们发现了一种新的溢出效应，增强了参与者维持合作的能力。这一发现表明，当参与者在多个重复博弈中同时互动时，观测误差的存在可以提高有效合作的可能性。我们的结果对产业组织、关系契约和国际合作具有重要启示。

articles.title_en: Group bargaining: A model of international treaty ratification
articles.title_cn: 群体谈判：国际条约批准的一个模型
articles.abstract_en: We consider non-cooperative bargaining over a fixed surplus between two groups that may differ in size and the supermajority threshold they employ for within-group ratification. We find that total allocation to a group does not depend on group size and increases with the supermajority threshold. We use the Gini coefficient to study within-group inequality as an outcome of interest and find that inequality increases with group size and decreases with the supermajority threshold. Finally, we study delegation by concentrating the ability to influence proposals within a subset of group members. Delegation to a subgroup decreases the group's total allocation because non-delegates accept lower allocations. Inequality is higher if delegation is employed, and it is decreasing in the size of the delegate committee.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑两个群体之间就固定剩余进行的非合作谈判，这两个群体可能在规模以及内部批准所采用的超级多数门槛上有所不同。我们发现，一个群体的总分配不依赖于群体规模，并随超级多数门槛的提高而增加。我们使用基尼系数来研究群体内部不平等作为感兴趣的结果，并发现不平等随群体规模增加而加剧，随超级多数门槛提高而减轻。最后，我们通过将影响提案的能力集中于群体成员的子集来研究授权。对子群体的授权会减少群体的总分配，因为非授权成员接受较低的分配。如果采用授权，不平等程度更高，并且随授权委员会规模的增大而降低。

articles.title_en: Cooperation, norms, and gene-culture coevolution
articles.title_cn: 合作、规范与基因-文化共同进化
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how a continuum of individuals interacting in a binary public goods game can secure cooperation through transmitting and enforcing norms. The evolutionary model consists of three distinct dimensions: behavior, norms, and approval preferences. In line with the indirect approach proposed by Güth and Yaari (1992), behavior results from utility maximization, while norms and approval preferences evolve over time. The underlying evolutionary processes differ concerning speed and nature. Whereas norms evolve at the cultural level through peer interactions and socialization, approval preferences are (at least partly) biologically inherited and transmitted from parents to their offspring. We find that if cultural and biological reproductive fitnesses are derived from material and social factors, then an interplay of social disapproval mechanisms gives rise to stable equilibria in which positive cooperation levels persist. Moreover, we find stable equilibria characterized by heterogeneous behavior and moral attitudes across individuals.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究在二元公共品博弈中，连续的个体如何通过传递和执行规范来确保合作。该进化模型包含三个不同维度：行为、规范和认可偏好。与Güth和Yaari（1992）提出的间接方法一致，行为源于效用最大化，而规范和认可偏好随时间进化。潜在的进化过程在速度和性质上有所不同。规范在文化层面通过同伴互动和社会化进化，而认可偏好（至少部分地）是生物遗传的，并从父母传递给后代。我们发现，如果文化和生物繁殖适应性来源于物质和社会因素，那么社会不认可机制的相互作用会产生稳定均衡，其中正合作水平得以持续。此外，我们发现以个体间异质行为和道德态度为特征的稳定均衡。

articles.title_en: Fair division with two-sided preferences
articles.title_cn: 双边偏好下的公平分配
articles.abstract_en: We study a fair division setting in which participants are to be fairly distributed among teams, where not only do the teams have preferences over the participants as in the canonical fair division setting, but the participants also have preferences over the teams. We focus on guaranteeing envy-freeness up to one participant (EF1) for the teams together with a stability condition for both sides. We show that an allocation satisfying EF1, swap stability, and individual stability always exists and can be computed in polynomial time, even when teams may have positive or negative values for participants. When teams have nonnegative values for participants, we prove that an EF1 and Pareto optimal allocation exists and, if the valuations are binary, can be found in polynomial time. We also show that an EF1 and justified envy-free allocation does not necessarily exist, and deciding whether such an allocation exists is computationally difficult.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个公平分配设置，其中参与者需要被公平地分配到各个团队中，不仅团队对参与者有偏好（如经典公平分配设置中那样），参与者对团队也有偏好。我们重点关注为团队保证至多一个参与者的无嫉妒性（EF1），同时为双方满足稳定性条件。我们证明，即使团队对参与者可能持有正或负的价值，满足EF1、交换稳定性和个体稳定性的分配总是存在，并且可以在多项式时间内计算。当团队对参与者持有非负价值时，我们证明存在一个EF1且帕累托最优的分配，并且如果估值是二值的，可以在多项式时间内找到。我们还表明，EF1且无合理嫉妒的分配不一定存在，并且判定这种分配是否存在在计算上是困难的。

articles.title_en: Revealed preference domains from random choice
articles.title_cn: 从随机选择中揭示的偏好域
articles.abstract_en: Ordinal random utility models (RUMs) are based on the presumption that fluctuating preferences drive stochastic choices. We study a novel property of RUM subclasses called exclusiveness, satisfied whenever the supports of all RUM representations of stochastic choice data, rationalizable by a RUM over preferences within a specific domain, also belong to that domain. We demonstrate that well-known preference domains such as the single-peaked, single-dipped, triple-wise value-restricted and peak-monotone are RUM-exclusive, alongside a novel domain we term peak-pit on a line. Building on existing characterization results, we show how these preference domains can be directly revealed from stochastic choice data, without the need to compute all RUM representations.
articles.abstract_cn: 序数随机效用模型（RUMs）基于这样一个假设：波动的偏好驱动随机选择。我们研究了RUM子类的一个新性质，称为排他性，当且仅当所有由特定域内偏好上的RUM可理性化的随机选择数据的RUM表示的支撑集也属于该域时，该性质得到满足。我们证明了诸如单峰、单谷、三重价值受限和峰单调等众所周知的偏好域是RUM排他的，同时我们提出了一种新域，称为线上的峰谷。基于现有的刻画结果，我们展示了如何直接从随机选择数据中揭示这些偏好域，而无需计算所有RUM表示。

articles.title_en: Can compulsory voting reduce information acquisition?
articles.title_cn: 强制投票能否减少信息获取？
articles.abstract_en: An election with full turnout is supposed to achieve an outcome that perfectly reflects the majority's preference. This result requires voters to be perfectly informed about their preferences and to vote accordingly. I show that incentivizing participation with an abstention fine does not necessarily incentivize information acquisition. While a small abstention fine always increases information acquisition compared to Voluntary Voting, a high abstention fine that achieves full turnout increases information acquisition only if voting costs are high. If voting costs are low, the opposite is true: Less individuals acquire information under Compulsory Voting with full turnout than under Voluntary Voting.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个全员参与的选举被认为能够实现完美反映多数人偏好的结果。这一结果要求选民充分了解自己的偏好并据此投票。我表明，用弃权罚款来激励参与并不一定会激励信息获取。虽然与自愿投票相比，小额弃权罚款总是能增加信息获取，但只有在投票成本高时，实现全员参与的高额弃权罚款才会增加信息获取。如果投票成本低，则情况相反：在全员参与的强制投票下，获取信息的个体少于自愿投票。

articles.title_en: Signaling motives in lying games
articles.title_cn: 说谎游戏中的信号动机
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the implications of agents signaling their moral type in a lying game. In the theoretical analysis, a signaling motive emerges where agents dislike being suspected of lying and where some lies are more stigmatized than others. The equilibrium prediction of the model can explain experimental data from previous studies, particularly on partial lying, where individuals lie to gain a non-payoff maximizing amount. I discuss the relationship with theoretical models of lying that conceptualize the image concern as an aversion to being suspected of lying and provide applications to narratives, learning, the disclosure of lies, and the selection into lying opportunities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在说谎游戏中，代理人传递其道德类型信号的含义。在理论分析中，出现了一种信号动机，即代理人厌恶被怀疑说谎，并且某些谎言比其他谎言更受污名化。该模型的均衡预测可以解释以往研究中的实验数据，特别是关于部分说谎的数据，即个体说谎以获得非收益最大化的金额。我讨论了与将形象关注概念化为厌恶被怀疑说谎的理论说谎模型的关系，并提供了对叙事、学习、谎言披露以及选择进入说谎机会的应用。

articles.title_en: Private signals and fast product adoption under incomplete information
articles.title_cn: 不完全信息下的私人信号与快速产品采用
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the dynamics of product adoption under incomplete information regarding the product quality. A new agent observes a small sample of product choices within the population and receives a noisy private signal regarding the realized state of the world. Using simple heuristics, the agent estimates both the product quality and the distribution of product choices in the population. The agent then chooses a product that is a best response to this estimate. We show that fast adoption of the optimal product in the population occurs if and only if the strength of the private signal exceeds a certain threshold.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在产品质量信息不完全的情况下产品采用的动态。一个新代理人观察总体中产品选择的小样本，并接收关于世界实现状态的噪声私人信号。使用简单启发式，代理人估计产品质量和总体中产品选择的分布。然后代理人选择对该估计最佳响应的产品。我们表明，当且仅当私人信号的强度超过某个阈值时，最优产品在总体中的快速采用才会发生。

articles.title_en: Changing collective action: Nudges and team decisions
articles.title_cn: 改变集体行动：助推与团队决策
articles.abstract_en: Nudges are widely used and a broad literature documents that they successfully affect individual behavior. However, in most settings where nudges are needed to change collective action, teams – not individuals – determine outcomes. Because team decision making is pervasive, learning whether nudges work with teams in social dilemmas is important, especially when formal enforcement is difficult. Here, we show that a nudge increases team cooperation by 14 to 16 percentage points in a social dilemma among fishing crews at Lake Victoria, Tanzania. The nudge is particularly effective when team decisions are made by a team member with leadership experience. Our findings are a proof of concept that expands the toolkit of empirical researchers and policy makers that address social dilemmas among teams.
articles.abstract_cn: 助推被广泛使用，大量文献记载了它们能成功影响个人行为。然而，在大多数需要助推来改变集体行动的情境中，决定结果的是团队而非个人。由于团队决策无处不在，了解助推在社会困境中是否对团队有效至关重要，尤其是在正式执法困难的情况下。在此，我们表明，在坦桑尼亚维多利亚湖的捕鱼船队所面临的社会困境中，助推使团队合作提高了14到16个百分点。当团队决策由具有领导经验的团队成员做出时，助推尤为有效。我们的发现是一个概念验证，扩展了实证研究人员和政策制定者应对团队间社会困境的工具箱。

articles.title_en: Manipulating the outcome of stable marriage and roommates problems
articles.title_cn: 操纵稳定婚姻与室友问题的结果
articles.abstract_en: The stable marriage and stable roommates problems have been extensively studied due to their applicability in various real-world scenarios. However, it might happen that no stable solution exists, or stable solutions do not meet certain requirements. In such cases, one might be interested in modifying the instance so that the existence of a stable outcome with the desired properties is ensured. We focus on three different modifications.
articles.abstract_cn: 稳定婚姻和稳定室友问题因其在各种现实场景中的适用性而被广泛研究。然而，可能不存在稳定解，或者稳定解不满足某些要求。在这种情况下，人们可能对修改实例感兴趣，以确保存在具有所需属性的稳定结果。我们关注三种不同的修改方式。

articles.title_en: To Catch a Stag: Identifying payoff- and risk-dominance effects in coordination games
articles.title_cn: 捕捉雄鹿：识别协调博弈中的收益优势与风险优势效应
articles.abstract_en: Five decades after Harsanyi and Selten's seminal work on equilibrium selection, we remain unable to predict the outcomes of real-life coordination even in simple cases. One reason is that experiments have struggled to quantify the effects of payoff- and risk-dominance and to separate them from context factors like feedback, repetition, and complexity. This experiment is the first to demonstrate that both payoff- and risk-dominance significantly and independently impact coordination decision-making. Three innovations characterize the design: First, payoff- and risk-dominance are disentangled using orthogonal measures of strategic incentives and welfare externalities. Second, a no-feedback, choice-list task format minimizes deviations from one-shot incentives. Third, beliefs about others' behavior are elicited. Strikingly, heterogeneous beliefs across the population rationalize not only reactions to risk dominance but also most reactions to payoff dominance. In addition, deviations from expected-value maximization in specific games suggest a minor role for social projection or other-regarding preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 在Harsanyi和Selten关于均衡选择的开创性工作五十年后，我们仍然无法预测现实生活中的协调结果，即使在简单情况下也是如此。一个原因是实验难以量化收益优势和风险优势的影响，并将其与反馈、重复和复杂性等背景因素分开。本实验首次证明收益优势和风险优势都显著且独立地影响协调决策。设计有三个创新点：第一，使用战略激励和福利外部性的正交度量来分离收益优势和风险优势。第二，无反馈、选择列表的任务格式最小化了对一次性激励的偏离。第三，引出了对他人行为的信念。引人注目的是，人群中异质的信念不仅合理化了对风险优势的反应，也合理化了对收益优势的大部分反应。此外，在特定游戏中偏离期望值最大化表明社会投射或他人关注偏好的作用较小。

articles.title_en: Pecuniary emulation and invidious distinction: Signaling under behavioral diversity
articles.title_cn: 金钱上的模仿与恶意区分：行为多样性下的信号传递
articles.abstract_en: We introduce behavioral diversity to an otherwise standard signaling model, in which a fraction of agents choose their signaling actions according to an exogenous distribution. These behavioral agents provide opportunities for strategic low-type agents to successfully emulate higher types in equilibrium, which in turn reduces the cost for strategic high-type agents to separate from lower types. Behavioral diversity thus improves the equilibrium payoffs to all types of strategic agents. The model also exhibits a convergence property, which is intuitively more appealing than the least-cost separating equilibrium of the standard setting.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将行为多样性引入一个在其他方面标准的信号传递模型，其中一部分代理人根据外生分布选择其信号行为。这些行为代理人为策略性低类型代理人在均衡中成功模仿更高类型提供了机会，这反过来降低了策略性高类型代理人与较低类型区分开来的成本。因此，行为多样性提高了所有类型策略性代理人的均衡收益。该模型还表现出一种收敛性质，这在直觉上比标准设定中的最低成本分离均衡更具吸引力。

articles.title_en: Skewness preferences: Evidence from online poker
articles.title_cn: 偏度偏好：来自在线扑克的证据
articles.abstract_en: We test for skewness preferences in a large set of observational panel data on online poker games (n=4,450,585). Each observation refers to a choice between a safe option and a binary risk of winning or losing the game. Our setting offers a real-world choice situation with substantial incentives where probability distributions are simple, transparent, and known to the decision-makers. Individuals reveal a strong and robust preference for skewness, which is inconsistent with expected utility theory. The effect of skewness is most pronounced among experienced and unsuccessful players but remains significant in all subsamples that we investigate, in contrast to the effect of variance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在在线扑克游戏的大型观测面板数据（n=4,450,585）中检验偏度偏好。每个观测值涉及在安全选项与赢或输游戏的二元风险之间的选择。我们的设置提供了一个具有实质性激励的现实世界选择情境，其中概率分布简单、透明且为决策者所知。个体表现出强烈且稳健的偏度偏好，这与期望效用理论不一致。偏度的影响在经验丰富但不成功的玩家中最为显著，但在我们调查的所有子样本中仍然显著，这与方差的影响形成对比。

articles.title_en: Stable partitions for proportional generalized claims problems
articles.title_cn: 比例广义索赔问题的稳定划分
articles.abstract_en: We consider a set of agents who have claims on an endowment that is not large enough to cover all claims. Agents can form coalitions but a minimal coalition size θ is required to have positive coalitional funding that is proportional to the sum of the claims of its members. We analyze the structure of stable partitions when coalition members use well-behaved rules to allocate coalitional endowments, e.g., the well-known constrained equal awards rule (CEA) or the constrained equal losses rule (CEL). For continuous, (strictly) resource monotonic, and consistent rules, stable partitions with (mostly) θ-size coalitions emerge. For CEA and CEL we provide algorithms to construct such a stable partition formed by (mostly) θ-size coalitions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一组代理人对一项不足以覆盖所有索赔的捐赠拥有索赔权。代理人可以组成联盟，但需要最小联盟规模θ才能获得与成员索赔总额成比例的正面联盟资金。当联盟成员使用行为良好的规则来分配联盟捐赠时，例如著名的约束等额奖励规则（CEA）或约束等额损失规则（CEL），我们分析稳定划分的结构。对于连续的、（严格）资源单调且一致的规则，会出现（大部分）由θ规模联盟组成的稳定划分。对于CEA和CEL，我们提供了构建这种由（大部分）θ规模联盟组成的稳定划分的算法。

articles.title_en: Measuring socially appropriate social preferences
articles.title_cn: 衡量社会适宜的社会偏好
articles.abstract_en: This paper extends the literature on structural estimation of social preferences to account for the desire to adhere to social norms and hide one's true intentions via moral wiggle room. We conduct an experiment to test whether accounting for normatively appropriate behavior allows us to distinguish between preference types who care about outcomes versus adhering to social norms and whether the introduction of moral wiggle room undermines the stability of social preference estimates. We find that social preference estimates are remarkably robust to the inclusion of moral wiggle room. However, the representative agent is strongly motivated by norms and failing to account for this motive in our model causes us to overestimate how much agents care about helping those who are worse off. Using finite mixture models to endogenously identify latent preference types, we replicate previous work finding that the majority of subjects can be classified as strong or moderate altruists when normative concerns are not considered. Accounting for the normative appropriateness of decisions when categorizing participants, however, reveals different motives across types: strong altruists are only marginally concerned with norms while the moderate altruists are highly sensitive to them and, once norms are taken into account, don't care at all about the outcomes of others. Our results thus recast the prior findings in a new light. Rather than the two most common types being strong altruists and moderate altruists, we find that they are better described as strong altruists and norm followers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文扩展了关于社会偏好结构估计的文献，以考虑遵守社会规范和通过道德模糊空间隐藏真实意图的愿望。我们进行了一项实验，以检验考虑规范适当行为是否能让我们区分关心结果与遵守社会规范的偏好类型，以及道德模糊空间的引入是否会破坏社会偏好估计的稳定性。我们发现，社会偏好估计对道德模糊空间的纳入表现出显著的稳健性。然而，代表性代理人受到规范的强烈驱动，而我们的模型未能考虑这一动机，导致我们高估了代理人帮助境况较差者的关心程度。使用有限混合模型内生识别潜在偏好类型，我们重复了先前的研究，发现在不考虑规范关注时，大多数受试者可以被归类为强利他主义者或中等利他主义者。然而，在分类参与者时考虑决策的规范适当性，揭示了不同类型之间的不同动机：强利他主义者仅对规范有轻微关注，而中等利他主义者对规范高度敏感，并且一旦考虑规范，他们完全不关心他人的结果。因此，我们的结果以新的视角重新诠释了先前的发现。我们发现，最常见的两种类型并非强利他主义者和中等利他主义者，而是更应被描述为强利他主义者和规范追随者。

articles.title_en: Stability and substitutability in multi-period matching markets
articles.title_cn: 多期匹配市场中的稳定性与可替代性
articles.abstract_en: We analyze a multi-period matching market where matching between agents is decided for each time period. To analyze this situation, we embed the situation into the framework of many-to-many matching with contracts where the contract includes the time period at which the matching occurs. While a general stability concept is already defined for the matching with contracts framework, in a multi-period matching model, a stable outcome may not exist when contracts exhibit complementarities across time periods. Thus, we define a weaker stability concept called temporal stability by taking into account the dynamic nature of the model. We provide sufficient conditions for the existence of a temporally stable outcome, including a corresponding substitutability condition, ordered substitutability, for the multi-period matching model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个多期匹配市场，其中代理人之间的匹配在每个时间段内决定。为了分析这种情况，我们将该情境嵌入到具有契约的多对多匹配框架中，其中契约包括匹配发生的时间段。虽然一般稳定性概念已在匹配与契约框架中定义，但在多期匹配模型中，当契约在时间段之间表现出互补性时，稳定结果可能不存在。因此，我们通过考虑模型的动态性质，定义了一个较弱的稳定性概念，称为时间稳定性。我们为时间稳定结果的存在提供了充分条件，包括相应的可替代性条件，即有序可替代性，适用于多期匹配模型。

articles.title_en: A note on motivated cognition and discriminatory beliefs
articles.title_cn: 关于动机认知与歧视性信念的注记
articles.abstract_en: In this note, we provide evidence that motivated reasoning can be a source of discriminatory beliefs. We employ a representative survey experiment in which we exogenously manipulate the presence of a need for justification of anti-social behavior towards an out-group. We find that survey participants devalue members of an out-group to justify taking away money from that group. Our results speak to a long-standing debate on the causes of racism and discrimination and suggest an important role of motivated cognition.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本注记中，我们提供证据表明动机推理可能是歧视性信念的一个来源。我们采用了一项具有代表性的调查实验，在其中外生地操纵了针对外群体反社会行为正当化需求的存在。我们发现，调查参与者会贬低外群体成员，以证明从该群体拿走金钱是合理的。我们的结果涉及关于种族主义和歧视原因的长期争论，并表明动机认知的重要作用。
